D: Two metalhead friends get their public access cable show picked up by a slick producer.
P: Serve the snacks when Bohemian Rhapsody comes on in the Mirthmobile.
S: Yeast doughnuts rolled in sugar and piped with raspberry jam

Fluffy little yeasted doughnuts fried golden, rolled in caster sugar and piped full of raspberry jam, served warm in a cardboard box. Warm 180ml milk with 30g butter and 2 tbsp caster sugar, add 7g yeast and 1 egg and mix into 350g plain flour with a pinch of salt. Knead 5 minutes and prove 1 hour. Roll into 20 balls and prove 20 minutes. Fry at 175C for 2 minutes, turning, until golden. Roll in caster sugar while warm, then poke a hole in each and pipe in raspberry jam.
headbanging in the back seat of the Mirthmobile

Big batch of popcorn tossed in butter, cheddar powder, chilli and smoked paprika, mixed with salty pretzels and passed round the back seat. Heat 2 tbsp oil in a large pot, add 120g popcorn kernels, cover and shake over medium heat until the popping slows. Melt 60g butter and pour over the popcorn. Mix 4 tbsp cheddar cheese powder, 1 tsp smoked paprika and half a tsp chilli powder and toss through until coated. Mix in 100g small pretzels and serve in a big bowl.
Small pizza rounds with sauce, mozzarella and a slice of pepperoni
Mini pepperoni pizzas on rounds of dough, baked at 230C for 8 minutes, presented to the camera with a cheesy grin.
M: Thin crust pizza with sauce, mozzarella and pepperoni, cut into squares

Pepperoni and mushroom pizza: thin sauce, low-moisture mozzarella, pepperoni and sliced mushroom, on a hot steel at max heat for 7 minutes, cut into squares. Stretch 500g dough into 2 thin bases. Spread with pizza sauce, add 250g mozzarella, 100g pepperoni and 150g sliced mushrooms. Bake on a hot steel or tray at the oven's highest heat for 7 minutes and cut into squares.

Franks griddled until blistered in steamed buns, loaded with beef chilli, melted cheddar, pickled jalapeños, diced onion and a stripe of mustard. Brown 300g beef mince with 1 diced onion, add 2 tsp chilli powder, 1 tsp cumin, 2 tbsp tomato paste and 200ml water and simmer 25 minutes. Griddle 8 franks for 6 minutes until blistered. Steam 8 hot dog buns. Fill each with a frank, a spoon of chilli and grated cheddar and grill 1 minute to melt. Top with jalapeños, diced onion and mustard.
W: Fried choux pastry crullers dipped in honey icing
Choux dough piped in rings onto baking paper, fried at 180C until puffed, dipped in a thin honey glaze.
K: Cherry syrup, vanilla ice cream and cold cola, topped with a cocktail cherry

Cold cola poured over vanilla ice cream with a splash of cherry syrup, foaming up in a big glass with a cocktail cherry on top. Chill 4 big glasses in the freezer for 10 minutes. Add 15ml cherry syrup and 2 scoops vanilla ice cream to each. Slowly pour 250ml cold cola down the side of each glass so the foam rises without spilling. Top with a cocktail cherry and serve with straws, label facing the camera.

steps.text: Warm the milk with the butter and a little of the sugar, then mix with the yeast, egg, flour and salt.
Knead until smooth and elastic.
Prove until doubled.
Roll into 20 balls and prove again.
Fry at 175C for a couple of minutes, turning, until golden.
Roll in the remaining sugar while warm, then poke a hole in each and pipe in raspberry jam.
Heat the oven to 230C. Roll out the dough and cut into 16 rounds.
Spread each with pizza sauce, add mozzarella and a slice of pepperoni.
Bake until bubbling.
Present one to the camera with a cheesy grin before eating.
Heat the oven to its highest setting with a steel or tray inside.
Stretch the dough into two thin bases.
Top with sauce, mozzarella, pepperoni and mushrooms.
Bake until the crust blisters. Cut into squares.
Boil the water and butter, beat in the flour and cook a minute. Cool.
Beat in the eggs one at a time.
Pipe rings onto squares of baking paper.
Fry at 180C, paper and all, until puffed, then lift the paper out.
Whisk the icing sugar with the honey and water and dip the crullers.
Chill four big glasses in the freezer.
Add cherry syrup and two scoops of ice cream to each.
Pour the cola slowly down the side so the foam rises without spilling.
Top with a cherry and serve with straws.
